items.name: Wroclaw Open 2007
items.information: Preregistration via internet is required. Preregistration closes June 24, 2007. This competition is open to all people from all countries. On-site registration on July 7, 2007 (Saturday) evening. Competition starts at 9:00am on Sunday.

items.name: US Open 2007
items.information: Prelims will be on the 16th. Semi-finals and finals will be on the 17th. Registration fee will be $10 plus $2 per main event and $2 for any and all side events. (10 base, add 2 for each additional main event, add 2 if they're doing any side events). Participation in side events will be limited only to people that pre-register.

items.name: San Diego competition 2007
items.information: The price of the competition is $5 for preregistered and $10 for not preregistered. Preregistration ends May 19. Send an e-mail to [Adam Zamora](mailto:mistizo858@hotmail.com) for preregistration. On-site registration will be from 9:00 till 10:00 and competition starts at 10am.

items.name: Captain's Cove competition 2007
items.information: The competition will be outside on a sort of boardwalk, but will be covered with a large tent. In case of bad weather, there will be room available inside. The entrance fee is $5, and the total money collected will be donated to Swim Across the Sound.

items.name: Italian Open 2007
